sources.snippet: A ROCmFP4 quantisation of Meta's Muse-Glimmer-30B for AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) unified-memory machines, shipped as a complete bundle: model + DFlash speculative drafter + vision projector.

sources.title: kingjones777/Muse-Glimmer-30B-ROCmFP4-Strix-Halo-DFlash-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Four ROCmFP4 quantisations of Meta's Muse-Glimmer-30B built for AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Radeon 8060S / gfx1151, bundled with the DFlash speculative drafter and vision projector. ROCmFP4 is a runtime tensor format that exists only in the ROCmFPX fork of llama.cpp; Muse Glimmer support exists only in current upstream — this build ports the model forward into the ROCmFPX base so the two can meet.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer - Meta
sources.snippet: An open 30B model for always-on local agents. Runs on a single GPU, Apache 2.0 licensed. Tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.

sources.title: muse-glimmer-30b Model by Meta | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer 30B is a multimodal reasoning model accepting text and images, with native tool-calling and separate reasoning output.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer — Meta's 30B AI Model for Your Laptop
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer is Meta's open-weight 30B model that runs on one consumer GPU. Free on Hugging Face, agentic capable, and built for local-first AI workflows.
